The normalized disk-average coefficient extractor has norm at most 1, equals 1 on W_xi, and tends to 0 on every T_f for fixed bounded f by translation of disks and dominated convergence. Thus every distance is at least 1, attained by f=0. The source-proven unitary Hermite STFT/Fock correspondence transfers it to bounded-mask Gabor localization. The exact checker verifies 256 supplementary finite Gaussian identities; this is not an infinite proof.

It answers the linear norm-closure part of an explicit outstanding true-polyanalytic Toeplitz question, sharpening previously known nonrepresentability into a quantitative gap.
